recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖第二組：異常族群（紅色）CD4 與 CD123 共表現、NG2 陽性、CD56 部分陽性，而 CD16、CD57、CD8、TCR、CD2、CD1a、CD38、cyMPO、cyCD79a、cyTdT、cyCD3 皆陰性，這組 CD4+/CD56+/CD123+ 的表型指向 BPDCN。
features: CD56 partially positive (about half the events) with CD16 negative
CD57, CD8, TCR alpha/beta, TCR gamma/delta, CD2 and CD1a negative
CD4 and CD123 co-expressed on the abnormal population
Cytoplasmic MPO, CD79a, TdT and CD3 negative, excluding myeloid, B- and T-lineage commitment
describe_en: Flow cytometry dot plots (panel 2) of the abnormal population (red) show partial CD56 expression without CD16, and absence of CD57, CD8, TCR alpha/beta, TCR gamma/delta, CD2 and CD1a. The cells co-express CD4 and CD123 and are NG2-positive and CD38-negative. Cytoplasmic MPO, CD79a, TdT and CD3 are all negative, excluding myeloid, B- and T-lymphoblastic lineage assignment. Together with CD7, CD33 and HLA-DR expression on the companion panel, the CD4+/CD56+/CD123+ phenotype is most suggestive of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monocytic AML may be CD4+/CD56+ but usually has MPO or nonspecific esterase activity and CD11b/CD14/CD64, whereas these cells are cyMPO-negative with bright CD123.
NK neoplasms are CD56+ with CD2, CD16 or cytoplasmic CD3 epsilon and are typically CD4-negative and CD123-negative, unlike this CD4+/CD123+ population.
T-ALL requires cytoplasmic CD3 and commonly TdT, both negative here.
